configuration.compileOnSave.enabled.mark: Always update the compiled PDF when a file is saved.
configuration.compileOutputFolderName.ma: The name of the folder where the compiled output files (e.g., `output.pdf`) is located. (Take effect after restarting VSCode)
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.markdownD: Configure the color themes used by the PDF viewer. (Take effect after restarting VSCode)
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.fontColor: The font color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.themes.backgroun: The background color of the theme.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultScrollMod: Configure the default scroll mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
configuration.pdfViewer.defaultSpreadMod: Configure the default spread mode used by the PDF viewer for new state. Existing saved viewer state takes precedence.
configuration.invisibleMode.historyRefre: The interval (in seconds) to refresh the project history in invisible mode, which is used to update the file changes, collaborator status, etc.
configuration.invisibleMode.chatMessageR: The interval (in seconds) to refresh the chat messages in invisible mode.
configuration.invisibleMode.inactiveTime: The timeout (in seconds) to mark a online Collaborator as inactivate in invisible mode.
configuration.colorTags.markdownDescript: Custom colors for collaborator tags. Provide exactly 6 hex colors in the order they should be assigned to first-seen collaborators.
configuration.diagnostics.enabled.markdo: Enable advanced diagnostics features, including subsystem filtering and structured state snapshots.
configuration.diagnostics.verbose.markdo: Emit verbose diagnostics (debug-level events) when diagnostics are enabled.
configuration.diagnostics.level.markdown: Minimum diagnostics level to emit. Use `warning` or `error` for low-noise operation.
configuration.diagnostics.enabledCategor: Restrict diagnostics to selected subsystems. Leave empty to include all subsystems.
configuration.diagnostics.maxBufferRecor: Maximum number of structured diagnostics records retained in memory.
configuration.diagnostics.includeErrorSt: Include stack traces in structured diagnostics for `Error` values.
configuration.diagnostics.consoleEnabled: Write diagnostics records to the extension host console.
Mirror diagnostics records to the Overleaf Workshop Diagnostics output channel.
configuration.comments.debug.enabled.mar: Enable structured comment debug diagnostics and developer utilities.
configuration.comments.debug.inline.mark: Include inline comment renderer diagnostics, including create-focus timing and pending inline focus state, when comment debug mode is enabled.
configuration.comments.debug.panel.markd: Include review panel and panel-suppression diagnostics, including automatic Comments panel suppression attempts, when comment debug mode is enabled.
configuration.comments.debug.sync.markdo: Include comment synchronization diagnostics when comment debug mode is enabled.
configuration.comments.debug.lifecycle.m: Include comment lifecycle and subscription diagnostics when comment debug mode is enabled.
configuration.comments.debug.eventBus.ma: Include EventBus registration, disposal, and emission diagnostics for comment-related events.
Emit invariant diagnostics for duplicate, drift, and identity conflicts in comment rendering.
